parsed.text: This packet contains panel p0 and p1 location distributions for red and blue roles on 4×4 local grids. Current distributions (copied/completed prior records at represented_time 12) are shown as current views and are not new estimates; conditional candidate records (commands k0,k1,k2) are hypothetical conditional estimates, not executed events. Summary of current: p0 and p1 nodes n1–n3 are uniform in many entries; both panels’ current n0 concentrate blue on the four cells {rows0–1,cols2–3} and red on the four cells {rows0–1,cols0–1}; node n3 in several current records concentrates blue at [1,1] and red at [0,2]. Conditional command variants differ primarily at node n0 and at some n0/n3 entries: some conditionals concentrate blue at [0,2] and red at [0,0], while others remain uniform. No field truths or presences are inferred; these are distributional peaks only.
